headlines.description: — Josh Doan scored two power-play goals, Alex Lyon made 32 saves and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Florida Panthers 3-0 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doan scores 2 goals and Lyon makes 32 saves as the Sabres beat the Panthers 3-0

events.name: New York Islanders at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Anders Lee and Kyle Palmieri scored in the third period to help the New York Islanders top the Ottawa Senators 5-4 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anders Lee and Kyle Palmieri help the Islanders top the Senators 5-4

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Jack Hughes scored twice, Jake Allen stopped 27 of the 30 shots he faced and the New Jersey Devils won their fourth game in a row by beating the Edmonton Oilers 5-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jack Hughes scores 2 goals as the Devils win their 4th in a row by beating the Oilers 5-3

events.name: Seattle Kraken at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Josh Mahura scored his first goal of the season at 3:06 of overtime to give the Seattle Kraken a 4-3 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Mahura scores in OT to lift the Kraken past the Maple Leafs, 4-3

events.name: New York Rangers at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Artemi Panarin had a goal and three assists as the New York Rangers rallied to beat the Montreal Canadiens 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panarin has goal, 3 assists as Rangers beat Canadiens 4-3 and improve to 3-0-1 on the road

headlines.description: — Noah Cates scored 2:36 into overtime to lift the Philadelphia Flyers to their second win of the season, 2-1 over the Minnesota Wild on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Noah Cates' overtime goal lifts Flyers to 2-1 win over Wild

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Kirill Marchenko scored early in the third period to rally Columbus over the Tampa Bay Lightning 3-2 on Saturday night, snapping a three-game skid and giving the Blue Jackets their first home victory of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marchenko’s third-period goal lifts Blue Jackets to first home win, 3-2 over Lightning

events.name: Dallas Stars at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Jordan Kyrou and Jimmy Snuggerud scored second-period goals, Jordan Binnington made 18 saves and the St. Louis Blues beat the Dallas Stars 3-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyrou, Snuggerud score to back Binnington in the Blues' 3-1 victory over the Stars

headlines.description: — Mark Scheifele scored a first-period power-play goal in the Winnipeg Jets' 4-1 win over the Nashville Predators on Saturday night to become the franchise's career points leader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scheifele becomes Jets franchise points leader with a goal in 4-1 win over Predators

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored twice and the Colorado Avalanche continued their strong start with a 4-1 win over the Boston Bruins on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nathan MacKinnon scores twice, Avalanche race past Bruins 4-1

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at Los Angeles Kings
Calgary Flames at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Marquee offseason acquisition Mitch Marner scored his first goals as a Golden Knight, and Mark Stone and Jack Eichel each had a four-point night Saturday to lead Vegas to a 6-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marner scores first goals as a Golden Knight in 6-1 win over Flames; Stone injured

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Sidney Crosby and Evgeni Malkin each had a goal and an assist, Tristan Jarry stopped 31 shots for his 22nd career shutout, and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the San Jose Sharks 3-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crosby and Malkin each have goal and assist, Jarry stops 31 shots as Penguins beat Sharks 3-0
